panel.title: My assistant
panel.description: Your sales assistant talks with you about your businesses using their real data.

errors.notAvailable: Your assistant isn't available for your account yet.
errors.sessionExpired: Your session expired. Sign in again to continue with your assistant.
errors.generic: Your assistant isn't responding right now. We're already looking into it.

activation.title: Activate your sales assistant
activation.description: With one click we set up your assistant with access to your businesses. You don't need to do anything else.
activation.terms: By activating it, your assistant shares abstract lessons from what you say or decide with SaleADS (never your data, numbers or names) to build skills for businesses like yours.

preparing.title: We're setting up your assistant
preparing.description: This takes a few minutes. You can leave this page: we'll let you know in “My assistant” when it's ready.

status.slow: This is taking a bit longer than usual. We'll let you know when it's ready.
status.failed: We're finishing setting up your assistant. We'll let you know when it's ready.

configureAi.title: Your assistant is installed
configureAi.description: Just one step left: set up your AI to start chatting.

ready.title: Your assistant is ready
ready.description: You can now chat with it about your businesses.

stopped.title: Your assistant is turned off
stopped.description: Your conversations and what it learned are still saved. Turn it back on whenever you want.

deleting.title: We're deleting your assistant
deleting.description: This takes a few minutes. When it's done you'll be able to activate a new assistant.

deactivateDialog.title: Turn off your assistant?
deactivateDialog.description: Your assistant will shut down and stop replying, including on any channels you connected. Your conversations and what it learned are kept, and you can turn it back on whenever you want.

deleteDialog.title: Delete your assistant?
deleteDialog.description: We'll remove your assistant and you won't be able to chat with it or recover it. Its memories are archived in SaleADS. Afterwards you can activate a brand-new assistant.

ai.title: Set up your AI
ai.description: Your assistant uses the AI you choose. Pick your provider, type the model, and paste the API key from your account.

fields.modelHint: Type the model name exactly as it appears in your provider account.
fields.keyHint: We test it when you save and never show it again.

validation.modelRequired: Type the model you want to use.
validation.keyRequired: Paste your API key to continue.

ai.testingHint: We're testing the connection with your provider. It can take up to a minute.

summary.title: Your AI is connected
summary.keyHidden: Your key is saved and will never be shown again.

results.ok: Done! Your AI is connected and you can start talking with your assistant.
results.invalidKey: That key doesn't work with the provider you chose. Check that the key belongs to that provider.
results.incompatibleModel: This model isn't compatible with your assistant. Try another model from your provider.
results.providerRejected: Your provider rejected the connection or didn't respond. Check your provider account and try again.
results.unreachable: We couldn't test your AI right now. Try again in a few minutes.

providers.error: We couldn't load the provider list. Try again.
providers.empty: There are no providers available for your assistant yet.

chat.title: Chat with your assistant
chat.empty: Ask anything about your businesses: how your sales and campaigns are doing, or what to do this week.
chat.historyError: We couldn’t load your previous conversation. You can keep writing.

composer.label: Write your message
composer.hint: Press Enter to send and Shift + Enter for a new line.
composer.tooLong: Your message is too long. Shorten it a bit to send it.

chat.mcpPaused: I’m reconnecting to your business data. You can keep writing: I’ll try again with your next message.

failure.generic: Your assistant couldn’t reply this time.
failure.auth: Your AI rejected the API key. Check your key in your AI provider account.
failure.quota: Your AI provider has no balance available. Top up your account with the provider and try again.
failure.rate_limit: Your AI provider is receiving too many requests. Wait a moment and try again.
failure.not_ready: Your assistant is still getting ready. Wait a few minutes and try again.
failure.restarting: Your assistant is restarting. Send your message again in a few seconds.

chat.whatsappQrHint: Scan it from WhatsApp → Linked devices → Link a device. If it expires, ask for a new one.

failure.ACTIVATION_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN: Meta didn't confirm the activation in time. Your team is checking; look at the campaign status in “My strategies” in a few minutes.
